product_code.detail: No Positron or sandbox product code changed during R4

new_dependencies.detail: No new npm packages, tools, or runtime dependencies introduced

new_agent_roles.detail: No new agent roles defined — Builder and Verifier roles unchanged

new_runtime_components.detail: No new server processes, workers, or runtime modules

architecture.detail: No architectural changes — module boundaries, data flow, and interfaces unchanged

evidence_quality.detail: R4 adds: capability baseline, safety boundary matrix, merkle root, SHA256SUMS, cross-run provenance audit

scope_clarity.detail: Issue #308 scope now clearly separated into validated vs. remaining. Safety boundaries explicitly documented.

complexity_assessment.detail: R4 adds significant evidence documentation but this is a one-time freeze operation. The governance overhead is appropriate for establishing an auditable baseline.

maintainability.duplication: MINIMAL — R4 references R1-R3 evidence; no copied content
maintainability.traceability: HIGH — every capability has evidence reference; every SHA is mapped across runs

ratio_assessment.product_benefit: Capability baseline enables informed decisions about next runs and provides auditable reference for stakeholders
ratio_assessment.evidence_cost: 25 R1-R3 files (53KB) + 20 R4 files (est. 80KB) = moderate one-time cost
ratio_assessment.verdict: FAVORABLE — evidence cost is justified by the auditability and clarity gained
